text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The "Spirit, Skill, Legs" Tournament to 
decide who graces the cover of the Tracen 
Academy admissions guide— At last, the 
final stage is...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Legs." A theme true to horse girls... 
However, a race would involve different 
aptitudes. Thus, they decided to determine 
the strongest by pure leg strength alone—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
To measure everyone's kicking power, we've 
introduced a specialized horse girl 
kicking machine!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We pride ourselves on its durability—it 
won't break even if a dump truck crashes 
into it♪ Please show off your leg strength 
to your heart's content!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
So whoever achieves the top score will 
become the new face of the academy. 
............

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone, please go ahead. I shall take 
my turn last.

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: —Eiyahh!!

text_block_list.name: Kick Machine
text_block_list.text:
"CURRENT RECORD: 1,000 KG. CURRENT RANK: 
15TH."
choice_data_list:
(In other words... an impact of 1 
ton...?!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stunned once again by the sheer leg power 
of horse girls... I watched over 
everyone's attempts. Once mostly everyone 
had finished, the one who stepped up was—

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
Then, I shall go next. ...Please, watch 
closely.

text_block_list.name: Kick Machine
text_block_list.text:
"CURRENT RECORD: -- KG. UNMEASURABLE. 
UNMEASURABLE. UNMEASURABLE..."

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
It seems there is nothing higher than 
this... Shall we consider the victor 
decided?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...I wonder about that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Muttering those words, Gentildonna 
casually stepped in front of the kicking 
machine, and—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: HNNNPHHH!!!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (*CRUNCHHH!!*)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In an instant, the entire venue fell 
dead silent. Before everyone's eyes stood 
the kicking machine, utterly demolished.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then. Does this mean I am the 
strongest?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —No. That is not it, is it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Following Gentildonna, she stepped onto 
the racetrack. And facing the horse girls 
in the stands—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A race. Everything comes down to the race! 
The strongest is determined solely through 
racing!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
A race tests Spirit, Skill, Legs... tests 
everything. Therefore, the victor is the 
strongest. A splendidly clear fact!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Here at Tracen Academy, there are many 
horse girls possessing diverse forms of 
strength...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
The more all of you give your everything, 
the greater the value of my victory 
becomes.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Come, let us compete! And become—the 
cornerstone of my glory.

text_block_list.name: Jungle Pocket
text_block_list.text:
Oho, now you're talking! If we're throwin' 
down, count me the hell in!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
I will not flinch this time. —Following 
this blood, I will claim the mantle of the 
strongest.

text_block_list.name: Vincennes
text_block_list.text:
...No. I won't yield to anyone else... The 
one who defeats you will be me. 
Gentildonna...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The original plan had gone completely off 
the rails... Yet at the same time, my 
heart was racing. Because this race— was 
going to be something truly extraordinary.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what splendid bloodthirst... it feels 
delightful. And what about you?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Orfèvre-san. You hear me, do you not?

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
...Your voice grates terribly upon my 
ears. Disturbing my rest...

text_block_list.name: Orfèvre
text_block_list.text:
I shall crush you lightly. Once made a 
loser, that mouth of yours should shut.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Fufu... fufufu. Ohohoho!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Very well. We shall settle everything with 
these "Legs", and then—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Standing at the pinnacle, the 
strongest—shall be none other than myself.
